# Definition 
**Pelvic Organ Prolapse** (POP) is herniation of a pelvic organ into the vagina.

# Management 
- **Asymptomatic:** reassurance & observation
- **Symptoms:**
	*in order of escalation*
	- Kegel
	- Pessary
	- Vaginal wall repair
